title: Push Sports Event Manager: Event Details refresh + hide location + multi-sport + date range

requirements.summary: Ensure Event Details always shows the latest just-saved event data after Voice Input save/edit without manual refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: After using Voice Input to populate fields and saving the event, opening the Event Details page shows the saved values (event name/type, date/time, organizer, payments, requirements, notes).
After editing an event (including changes coming from Voice Input) and saving, returning to Event Details shows updated values immediately.
No manual browser refresh is required for Event Details to show the newest saved data.

file_operations.description: Adjust the get-event query behavior to avoid stale Event Details data (e.g., set refetchOnMount/refetchOnWindowFocus appropriately and ensure staleTime does not prevent fetching newly-saved values). Also ensure add/update mutations invalidate/refetch the specific event query key used by Event Details.
Ensure Event Details triggers a fresh read when navigated to after save/edit (e.g., call refetch on mount or rely on updated query options) so the view reflects the latest saved values immediately.

After creating an event, navigate in a way that results in Event Details reading fresh data (e.g., navigate to the Event Details route for the returned id and ensure relevant queries are invalidated/refetched rather than relying on potentially stale cached data).
After updating an event, ensure navigation back to Event Details is paired with query invalidation/refetch so the user immediately sees the updated saved values.

requirements.summary: Hide the location section on Event Details while leaving stored location data and Add/Edit forms unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Event Details page no longer renders the Location label/value or the location icon/section.
All other Event Details sections (date/time, organizer, payment summary, requirements, notes, actions) continue to work.

file_operations.description: Remove the Location UI block (including MapPin icon and label/value rendering) from Event Details while keeping all other sections intact.

requirements.summary: Allow selecting multiple sports in Add/Edit Event and display all selected sports on Event Details, with sensible handling of older single-sport events.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Event form allows selecting more than one sport for an event.
Edit Event form loads and allows modifying the previously selected multiple sports.
Event Details shows all selected sports (not just one).
Existing events that only have a single sport/event type continue to display sensibly (e.g., treated as a single selected sport).

file_operations.description: Extend the form model and adapter to support sports as an array (mapping backend Event.sports <-> form data). Include backward-compatible mapping for older/single-sport representations (e.g., derive a single sport from existing metadata eventType when sports is missing/empty).

Replace the single event type selector with a multi-select sports UI (e.g., checkbox group and/or add-custom-sport input) that updates form data as an array of selected sports; keep labels in English.
Update the details header/summary to render all selected sports (e.g., multiple badges) instead of a single event type field.

Update Voice Input parsing to support extracting multiple sports from recognized text (e.g., detect multiple sport keywords and return them as an array), while remaining compatible with single sport mentions.

requirements.summary: Use a From–To date range for Add/Edit Event and show the range on Event Details, keeping calendar logic working using range start date for existing sorting/filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Event form captures an event date range with a start (From) date and an end (To) date.
Edit Event form loads an existing event’s date range and allows editing it.
Event Details displays the date range in a clear From–To format.
Existing events without an end date continue to work (e.g., end date defaults to start date or displays as a single-day range).
Calendar sorting/highlighting and month filtering continue to function (at minimum using the range start date as the event’s primary date for existing logic).

file_operations.description: Update the form model and adapter to store a date range (From/To) and map to/from backend Event.dateRange. Add safe defaults so missing end dates behave as single-day ranges. Provide a consistent 'primary date' (range start) used by existing calendar/filtering logic.
Change the single Event Date input into two date inputs labeled in English ("From" and "To") and bind them to the form date range state; ensure validation and submission uses the range.
Update Date & Time display to show the From–To date range clearly; if end equals start (or absent), display as a single-day range or equivalent clear format.

Update calendar sorting/highlighting/month filtering helpers to use the event range start date as the primary date (rather than a single event date field), preserving existing behaviors as closely as possible.

Update Calendar page event rendering to use the new date range-aware enriched form data (e.g., remove reliance on a single stored date field and ensure date selection shows events whose primary date matches the selected day).
Update Voice Input parsing to recognize and populate date ranges when users speak a from-to date (while still supporting single-date utterances by setting To = From).
Align add/update event mutations to send/receive the backend's dateRange structure (and ensure queries return date-range-aware event data for downstream calendar/month filtering).
Update initial form defaults and draft restore logic to store/restore the From/To date range (ensuring stored drafts from older single-date format still load sensibly).
Ensure the edit form loads an event’s date range into the From/To inputs using the updated adapter, and that saving preserves the range.
